overview: A one-page State Department cross-reference sheet concerning an October 19, 1936 communication from Hoover at Hong Kong about proposed Bank of Formosa special loans to Japanese merchants, farmers, and industrialists operating in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies. The sheet directs the reader to file 894.51/474 and notes that the communication forwarded an October 17 clipping from the South China Morning Post, apparently in connection with a despatch addressed to the Embassy.

people.name: Hoover
people.role: Official at Hong Kong; sender of the referenced communication

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on Bank of Formosa loans in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies
subfiles.about: The sheet refers to another file a communication about proposed Bank of Formosa loans to Japanese economic actors in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies.
subfiles.summary: This filing note directs readers to document 894.51/474 for an October 19, 1936 communication from Hoover at Hong Kong to the Embassy. The referenced material concerned special Bank of Formosa loans for Japanese merchants, farmers, and industrialists in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies. It also involved an October 17 clipping from the South China Morning Post forwarded with or in connection with a despatch to the Embassy.

interest: The sheet is useful as evidence of how the State Department indexed reports on Japanese financial and commercial expansion in Southeast Asia. Although it does not preserve the underlying clipping or despatch, it identifies the Bank of Formosa as a prospective source of preferential credit for several classes of Japanese settlers and investors, and supplies a cross-reference through which the fuller report may be traced.
